report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

What I do see:
- The difference is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 across many layers, suggesting a changed BOS/start-of-sequence prior rather than a targeted skill.
- Logit-lens readouts skew toward capitalized/proper-noun tokens and “headline-y” adjectives (iconic, tragic, vivid, timeless), with occasional “died/tragic/tragedy” clusters and news-y proper names. There are also scattered multilingual fragments (på, jeg, von/van).
- This looks like a broad stylistic prior shift (more title/headline/capitalized-word bias at the start) rather than a clear, nameable objective such as instruction-following, coding, math, safety, etc.

So while there’s a weak hint of “news/entertainment headline style” emphasis, the evidence doesn’t support confidently naming a specific objective or domain.
